en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of an old European city with narrow brick houses, tiled roofs, and a canal running alongside a cobbled street. A stone bridge crosses the canal in the middle distance, and several church spires and a tall belfry tower rise above the skyline. At the top of the card it reads "Bruges – Panorama." The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
